name: ROOT
Description: Starting the interview

name: ANXIETYROOT
Description: ICEBREAKING. Check for anxiety mood

name: SUB
Description: Determine if the patient's anxiety is primarily due to the physiological effects of a substance, such as drugs, alcohol, or medications for any medical conditions.

name: SUB_DIST
Description: Determine if the patient's anxiety mood is associated with disturbance in attention and awareness is characterized by a fluctuating course.

name: SIDELIRIUM
Description: Substance Intoxication Delirium; Substance withdrawal delirium; Medication-Induced Delirium

name: SUB_DIST_SEV
Description: Evaluate if the anxiety mood reported by the patient is the primary focus of the clinical picture and is of sufficient severity to require clinical attention.

name: SIANX
Description: Substance/Medication-Induced Anxiety Disorder

name: SI
Description: Substance Intoxication; Substance Withdrawal; Other Adverse Effect of Medication

name: MED
Description: Determine if the patient's anxiety mood is primarily caused by the physiological effects of a general medical condition, such as physical health issues.

name: MED_DIST
Description: Evaluate if the anxiety mood reported by the patient is the primary focus of the clinical picture and is of sufficient severity to require clinical attention.

name: MEDDELIRIUM
Description: Delirium Due to Another Medical Condition

name: MED_DIST_SEV
Description: Assess whether the patient shows evidence of decline in one or more cognitive domains, including complex attention, executive function, learning and memory, language, perceptual-motor abilities, or social cognition.

name: MNEUD
Description: Major or Mild Neurocognitive disorder due to another medical condition, with behavioral disturbance

name: MEDANX
Description: Anxiety Disorder Due to Another Medical Condition

name: FEAR
Description: Determine if the patient's anxiety occur in the context of an abrupt surge of intense fear and discomfort that reaches a peak within minutes.

name: PANICATTACK
Description: Panic Attack

name: PANICSEV
Description: Determine if the patient experiences recurrent, unexpected panic attacks that are clinically significant.

name: PANICDISORDER
Description: Panic Disorder

name: PLACE
Description: Determine if the patient experiences anxiety about being in places or situations where escape might be difficult or embarrassing in the event of a panic attack or panic-like symptoms. .

name: AGORAPHOBIA
Description: Agoraphobia

name: SPERATION
Description: Determine if the patient experiences anxiety or worry specifically related to separation from major attachment figures.

name: SEPANX
Description: Separation Anxiety Disorder

name: SOCIAL
Description: Determine if the patient experiences anxiety or worry specifically about social situations where they are exposed to the scrutiny of others.

name: SOCIALANX
Description: Social Anxiety Disorder

name: FEAROBJ
Description: Determine if the patient experiences anxiety about exposure to a feared object (e.g., spiders) or situation (e.g., getting an injection, flying).

name: SPEPHOBIA
Description: Specific Phobia

name: HEALTH
Description: Determine if the patient experiences anxiety specifically about their health and the possibility of having or acquiring a serious illness. .

name: SOMATIC
Description: Determine if the patient experiences somatic symptoms that are distressing. .

name: SOMATICD
Description: Somatic Symptom Disorder

name: SEV_PHYS
Description: Determine if the patient's belief about having a serious physical illness reaches a delusional intensity.

name: PSYCHD
Description: Psychotic Disorder

name: ILLANX
Description: Illness Anxiety Disorder

name: DISCARD
Description: Check if the patient feels anxious about getting rid of personal items, leading to a buildup of possessions that clutter their living spaces.

name: HOARDINGD
Description: Hoarding Disorder

name: APPEARANCE
Description: Check if the patient feels anxious or worried about a perceived flaw in their appearance that is not noticeable to others.

name: BODYDD
Description: Body Dysmorphic Disorder

name: REC
Description: Check if the patient experiences anxiety linked to repeated worries, thoughts, or excessive overthinking.

name: INTRUSIVE
Description: Check if the patient has recurring thoughts that are experienced as intrusive, unwanted, and conflicting with their sense of self.

name: OBSESSIVE
Description: Obsessive-complusive Disorder

name: GENERALIZEDANX
Description: Generalized Anxiety Disorder

name: TRAUMA
Description: Check if the patient experiences anxiety related to exposure to a severe traumatic event, accompanied by intrusive symptoms (such as flashbacks or nightmares), avoidance of reminders of the trauma, negative changes in thoughts and mood, and increased arousal or reactivity.

name: TRAUMA_DUR
Description: Criteria met if the patient's stress disorder symptoms last more than a month.

name: PTSD
Description: Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder

name: ASD
Description: Acute Stress Disorder

name: MANIC
Description: Check if the patient experiences anxiety that is associated with a manic episode, a hypomanic episode, or a major depressive episode.

name: MDDANX
Description: Major Depressive Episode with Anxious feawtures in major depressive, bipolar I, or BipolarII disorder

name: OTH
Description: The criteria are met if the patient exhibits a maladaptive response to a psychosocial stressor, meaning their response is disproportionate or ineffective, leading to significant distress or impairment in functioning.

name: PSYCHSTRESSOR
Description: Check if the patient's symptoms occur in response to a psychosocial stressor.

name: NORMALANX
Description: Normal Anxiety

name: ADJD
Description: Adjustment Disorder With Anxiety

name: OTHANX
Description: Other specified anxiety disorder; Unspecified anxiety disorder

name: NORMAL
Description: No Anxiety Mood
